author: Steve Wallis
description:
We built a drivable tent and took it camping. Excellent suggestion from my lovely Lindsey! The whole tent took a few rebuilds and many tweaks before it was even remotely roadworthy. Thankfully, there was a quiet campground calling our name and we went to test drive it and camp for the night. The whole thing is built out of parts from a drift hero go-kart. In retrospect I should have just started with a go kart and built a tent around it but it was a learning adventure. Moderately healthy camping meal, a few laughs, a few drinks. Our troubles are over!
